selector_policy.selector_or_offset: line selector or section-local navigation pointer
selector_policy.guard: Selector and snippet help the reader open the right place; they are not evidence support.

action_pack_policy.guard: Action mode prepares anchors only; evidence support check must run before final action-facing use.

route_cards.label: Source Route Front Door
route_cards.plain_rule: Start from source type and intended use before ranking search hits.
route_cards.implementation_hint: Show source routes first: repo/library, article/web, paper, video, Obsidian note, previous sandbox/check.
route_cards.risk_guard: A visible source route is navigation; it is not authority.

route_cards.label: Ingestion And Parser Route
route_cards.plain_rule: Parser, connector, and chunk method are source hygiene, not proof.
route_cards.implementation_hint: Expose source_type, content_form, parser/connector trace, and raw anchor availability.
route_cards.risk_guard: Chunk metadata and parser output stay raw/candidate until evidence review.

route_cards.label: Metadata Router And Trace
route_cards.plain_rule: Use metadata to slice retrieval after authority/status filters.
route_cards.implementation_hint: Show hard filters, lane counts, selected items, excluded items, and content_trace_policy.
route_cards.risk_guard: Metadata route hit is not confidence, truth, or action readiness.

route_cards.label: Citation And Clickback Route
route_cards.plain_rule: Citation UI is a drilldown affordance; evidence support is a later check.
route_cards.implementation_hint: Pack items should display source_ref, selector_or_offset, citable_status, and action readiness.
route_cards.risk_guard: A citation link is not evidence support unless the cited span supports the specific point.

route_cards.label: Action Safety Route
route_cards.plain_rule: Action packs can prepare anchors, but candidate/overlay/audit material cannot become final support.
route_cards.implementation_hint: Always emit action_readiness:not_ready until a raw/reviewed anchor has been opened and checked.
route_cards.risk_guard: Do not let route convenience override knowledge_status or retrieval_policy.
